verdict.rationale: The evidence covers installing and authoring plugins and skills, which users invoke inside Codex or ChatGPT sessions. Nothing shows plugins setting up scheduled, recurring or autonomous background automations. The `hooks.json` companion surface and MCP event-subscription and webhook docs are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not a documented background-automation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
